note: IMPORTANT DIRECTION FINDING: the declared HS 844720 ('flat knitting machines') is not a product this company ships out — it is machinery it IMPORTS from China (Zhejiang Tongtai, Zhuji Huitian) through Sahnewal Ludhiana ICD, most recently 2025-12-02. The claimed industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is contradicted by the customs record, which shows textile/knitting machinery. So the declared HS appears to describe purchased equipment, not the company's own supply profile; the actual trading role visible in data is importer/trader of Chinese knitting and embroidery machines into Punjab. Per Rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection — the company stays in the base and the HS should be corrected to the factual profile once the company's own outbound product is established. Per Rule 5: no export shipments and no domestic supply traces were found in accessible sources — 'следов поставок не найдено' on the export side; domestic side is genuinely unknown (not 'none_found') because the search backend was down and the paid trade databases blocked free access, so absence of evidence there is a tooling gap, not a finding. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source reached. Recommended next step: pull the full 114-record ImportKey set and a paid Volza/Eximpedia export view to confirm whether any outbound leg exists at all.
